svg.title: Synthetic test accuracy by training rows, v1 to v4
svg.desc: Line chart of mean accuracy on the 60-row synthetic test against training rows: base (0 rows) 44.0%, v1 (240 rows) 79.8%, v2 (400 rows) 83.7%, v3 (520 rows) 96.2%, v4 (720 rows) 97.8%. A separate point shows the same v4 at 72.0% on 30 sealed real requests.

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
